name: ended-stop-answers-as-a-plain-stop
description: A CoherentVolume reports an attempt it no longer uses by sending "ended": true with the attempt's agent_id on a session-stop (#525). The stop answers exactly as one without the flag: attempt a0826622451ec196f of session 66666666 holds EXCLUSIVE on notes.md, and its ended stop releases it and lists it in released_artifacts, in the shape warn_mode's session-stop-releases-two-held-paths pins for a stop without the flag. A peer session holds a read of other.md, as in the two status rows, so all three run the same setup. Forgetting the attempt's records happens after the releases and changes nothing in the answer; ended-stop-removes-the-attempt-from-status shows what it removes. Both backends.
